scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Silent Aim, Aimbot, FOV Circle, Full ESP  + More
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Cold War uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift. Its ESP covers boxes, names, classes, distance, weapon, health bars, limb health, status flags, skeletons, tracers, and head dots, with visibility, teammate, and vehicle options. The aimbot locks the camera onto valid targets with hotkey, always-on, or while-firing modes, and offers target bone selection, ballistic prediction, visible checks, sticky targeting, and a FOV circle. Smoothing and humanization controls include separate horizontal and vertical speeds, reaction delay, wind-up, and a speed ceiling, plus target filters for downed and spawn-protected players. Silent aim includes hit bone, FOV, hit chance, distance, lead, and its own FOV circle, with a ballistics engine status readout. World options clear fog, enable fullbright, and disable the suppression effect. An Info tab shows match overview, staff detection, and a security note, while Settings handles theme and saved configs. A panic key halts combat features instantly.

scripts.title: ESP, Aimbot & Silent Aim | Vehicle ESP | Free, No Key
scripts.features:
ESP, aimbot and silent aim for Cold War [VIETNAM], the 80-player NATO vs PACT shooter. Open the panel with RightShift and switch on what you want.

FEATURES
- ESP: box, name, class (Sniper, AT, Machinegun, Medic ...), weapon, distance in meters, a health bar built from all six limbs, head and torso health, skeleton, tracers and head dot
- Status flags DOWNED, SPAWN, DISGUISED and VEHICLE, a wall check that highlights visible enemies, teammates optional
- Vehicle ESP for enemy vehicles, judged by the crew's team, so captured vehicles show up on the right side
- Aimbot: a camera aimbot that compensates bullet drop and leads moving targets with the game's own ballistics. FOV circle, sticky target, visible only, a humaniser (reaction delay, wind-up, speed ceiling) and a panic key
- Silent aim: bends your real shot onto enemies only, never teammates, and only when the bullet can really reach them. Head / Torso / Nearest / Random, FOV in degrees, hit chance and lead. Off by default
- World: no fog, fullbright, no suppression blur
- Info: tickets, your K/D and a staff detector

MOBILE
Works on PC and mobile - the panel asks once and scales itself, in German, English and Russian.

HOW TO RUN
1. Open Cold War [VIETNAM]
2. Paste the loader into your executor
3. Execute - the panel opens by itself
4. Press RightShift to show or hide it

No key, no ads, and it never spends Robux.
